content.text: Berthier blinks at the dispatch. "Sire, I cannot make that out at all. Might you mean an order such as \"Ney, attack Mack\"?"

recorded.note: authored from the recon prototype's measured shapes — never a model's answer; the recorder promotes it to provenance 'recorded'

notes: The Berthier text-mode recovery answer for the gibberish request — the SECOND cassette one request consumes.
